contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IVL CONST[--]VG ; R/ VI[---]AVGG NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, possibly of Constantius II (323-361), Trier mint Virtus Augg NN issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. Chipped. RIC vol. 8 page 144 no. 74. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL CONST[--]VG. Reverse description: Virtus standing left with vertical spear, shield propped right. Reverse inscription: VI[---]AVGG NN. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 1.10gms, die axis: 12
